info.title: Upskalor CRM Backend API
info.description: Comprehensive API documentation for Upskalor CRM Backend, including Health Probes, Multi-Tenant Authentication & RBAC, Sales Lead Intake & Transfers, and Solar Quotations Management.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Company registration, user authentication, and token management

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Administrative operations, RBAC permissions, and role assignments

tags.name: Leads
tags.description: Sales lead intake, status tracking, executive assignment, and activity timeline

tags.name: Lead Transfers
tags.description: Bulk lead CSV upload/import with error reporting, and asynchronous CSV/Excel exports

tags.name: Quotations
tags.description: Solar project quotation creation, financial summaries, line items, and lifecycle management

tags.name: Site Surveys
tags.description: Site survey scheduling, technical specifications, photo management, and technician assignments

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Project creation from accepted quotations, lifecycle tracking, and milestone definitions

tags.name: Payments & Receipts
tags.description: Payment transactions, receipt generation, PDF downloads, WhatsApp sharing, and collections dashboard

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Customer invoice creation, sequential numbering, status updates, and cancellations

bearerAuth.description: Enter the JWT access token returned by `/auth/login`.

total.description: Optional total override; auto-calculated as qty * rate * (1 + gstRate/100) if omitted

quoteNumber.description: Optional custom quote number; auto-generated as QT-YYYY-XXXX if omitted

get.description: Checks if the server process is alive.
Checks if the server is ready to accept incoming requests.

post.description: Provisions a new tenant database schema and creates the initial super_admin account.

201.description: Company and owner account created successfully

409.description: Company slug or owner email already exists

post.description: Authenticates a tenant user and returns JWT access and refresh tokens.
Issues a new JWT access and rotated refresh token using an active refresh token.
Grants or updates permissions for a role in the company schema.
Updates the role assigned to a company user.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of sales leads with search, filtering, and sorting.

post.description: Creates a new customer sales lead in the tenant schema and logs an activity record.

patch.description: Updates editable fields of an existing lead and records activity changes.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the lead and logs a deletion activity.

get.summary: Get Import Error Report Download URL

get.description: Returns a paginated list of solar project quotations with search, filters, and customer lead details.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Searches quote number and lead customer name

parameters.name: leadId
parameters.description: Filter quotations for a specific lead

post.description: Creates a quotation with basic details, payment split percentages, line items, and financial summary auto-calculations. Also logs activity on the associated lead.

400.description: Validation error or invalid lead ID

get.description: Retrieves full details of a quotation including all line items and associated lead metadata.

patch.description: Updates quotation attributes, financial fields, and optionally replaces line items with auto-recalculation of totals.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the quotation and logs an activity record on the associated lead.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of site surveys with search, filters, sorting, and linked lead info. Role-scoped to technician for user role unless admin requests viewAll=true.

post.description: Creates and schedules a site survey. When linked to a lead, runs inside a transaction to update lead status to SURVEY_SCHEDULED and records audit activities. Returns non-blocking warning if technician has an overlapping survey within 45 minutes.

get.description: Returns full details for a survey including technical specs, attached photos, and linked lead summary.

patch.description: Updates technical specifications and details. Logs SURVEY_RESCHEDULED if surveyDateTime is changed and linked to a lead.

delete.description: Soft deletes the survey by setting deleted_at = now().

patch.description: Validates state machine transitions: Scheduled -> In Progress, Completed, Cancelled; In Progress -> Completed, Cancelled, Scheduled; Completed -> Cancelled (Admin only); Cancelled -> Scheduled.
Assigns a technician to a survey. Performs technician overlap check within 45 minutes.

post.description: Saves photo metadata linked to the survey.

delete.description: Deletes photo metadata from the survey.

get.description: Returns full survey history for a specific lead ordered by surveyDateTime desc.
Returns paginated solar installation projects with filtering and sorting.

post.description: Creates a project from an accepted quotation and auto-generates 3 milestones.

get.description: Returns project details with milestones, receipts, and balance summary.

patch.description: Updates project name, status, or phone.

delete.description: Soft-deletes project and cascades to milestones, receipts, and invoices.

post.description: Adds a custom milestone to a project.
Records payment against a milestone with optional auto-invoicing.

get.description: Returns all payment receipts across projects.
Returns receipt details with nested project, milestone, and invoice.

patch.description: Admin voids receipt and reverses milestone balance and invoices.

post.description: Generates formatted WhatsApp message and direct click URL.

get.description: Generates and downloads a formatted PDF payment receipt.
Aggregated view of outstanding project balances.
Aggregated metrics for total outstanding, collections this month, overdue receivables, and trend.

post.description: Cron trigger to mark overdue milestones and invoices.

get.description: Returns paginated invoices across all projects.

post.description: Creates a manual invoice with auto-generated sequential number.

delete.description: Cancels invoice (requires admin if already Paid).

patch.description: Transitions invoice status (Unpaid, Paid, Overdue, Cancelled).
